scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
Ah! An Archbishop.
You have reached the state of light.
scripts.translation: 你已達到了光明的境界。

scripts.text: I hope you give happiness and honor to people during your adventures.
scripts.translation: 願你在冒險中為人們帶來幸福與榮耀。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
In front of the Almighty God Odin,
there shall be no person smarter than him,
and there will be no person more merciful than him.
[Praying Minister]
All ministers of Odin should be diligent. They should never be too lazy to serve Odin.
scripts.translation: 奧丁的所有牧師都應勤勉。他們絕不應因懶散而怠慢對奧丁的侍奉。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
These days, I've heard that ministers are becoming lax in their duty to Odin and adorn themselves with the splendors of the world.
scripts.translation: 最近，我聽說有些牧師對侍奉奧丁的職責變得懈怠，反而沉迷於世俗的榮華富貴。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
If you see any of these ministers, can you ask to them to go to the church in prontera?
scripts.translation: 如果你遇到這樣的牧師，能否請他們去普隆德拉的教堂一趟？

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
They give out a special aura so you can easily recognize them.
scripts.translation: 他們會散發出特殊的氣息，所以很容易辨認。

scripts.text: I'm going to make them ministers worthy of serving Odin.
scripts.translation: 我會讓他們成為配得上侍奉奧丁的牧師。

scripts.text: You can't change jobs without using all your skill points. Please use all of your skill points before applying to change jobs~
scripts.translation: 你必須用完所有技能點才能轉職。請在申請轉職前用完所有技能點~

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
In front of the Almighty God Odin,
there shall be no person smarter than him,
and there will be no person more merciful than him.
[Praying Minister]
All ministers of Odin should be diligent. They should never be too lazy to serve Odin.
scripts.translation: 奧丁的所有牧師都應勤勉。他們絕不應因懶散而怠慢對奧丁的侍奉。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
{0}, how has your life been? Have you lived it to its fullest?
scripts.translation: {0}，近來過得如何？日子過得充實嗎？

scripts.text: Have you served your life in the light of Odin?
scripts.translation: 你是否始終沐浴在奧丁的光輝下？

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
We are ministers and our behavior is seen as acts of the Gods.
scripts.translation: 我們是牧師，我們的行為被視為神明的作為。

scripts.text: We should always be mindful of this.
scripts.translation: 我們必須時刻銘記這一點。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
We should always tell the truth.
We should not fall prey to lies and deceit.
scripts.translation: 我們不應陷入謊言與欺騙之中。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
Even though we serve Odin, we are normal people.
scripts.translation: 儘管我們侍奉奧丁，但我們也是普通人。

scripts.text: We can be degraded in spite of ourselves and we must realize that.
scripts.translation: 我們可能會在不知不覺中墮落，我們必須意識到這一點。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
We always try to keep our original intention in mind and spread Odin's rule.
scripts.translation: 我們總是努力銘記初心，並傳播奧丁的教義。

scripts.text: How do I become like that?
[Praying Minister]
That's a good question.
We have lots of methods.
But, I recommend this.
[Praying Minister]
Have you ever heard of a ^3131FFHoly Pilgrimage^000000?
A Holy Pilgrimage means going to a holy place to pray to the God Odin for protection and grace.
scripts.translation: 神聖朝聖是指前往聖地，向奧丁神祈禱，祈求庇佑與恩典。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
When you pray to Odin in the holy place, you will feel that you are born again.
scripts.translation: 當你在聖地向奧丁祈禱時，你會感到自己獲得了新生。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
What do you think?
Would you like to do a Holy Pilgrimage?
scripts.translation: 你願意進行一次神聖朝聖嗎？

scripts.text: Yes I want to.
I'll think about it.
[Praying Minister]
That's the correct attitude.
A person who lives in one's mundane life would better have a new mind and body and evolve to the way of a true minister of Odin.
scripts.translation: 身處塵世，更應洗滌身心，努力成為真正侍奉奧丁的牧師。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
There is a small village named Umbala far from here.
scripts.translation: 遠方有個名叫汶巴拉的小村莊。

scripts.text: That village is a where a tribe lives in harmony with nature.
scripts.translation: 村裡的部族與大自然和諧共處。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
Go there and find Priest Dayan.
Tell him exactly,
scripts.translation: 記得原原本本地告訴他：

scripts.text: '^3131FFI'm here for the Holy Pilgrimage.^000000'
[Praying Minister]
He's very old so he is hard of hearing.
scripts.translation: 他年紀很大，耳朵不太好使。

scripts.text: You have to speak loud and clearly. You got it?
scripts.translation: 你必須大聲且清晰地說話。明白了嗎？

scripts.text: I hope that this paves the way for you to live in the light of Odin.
scripts.translation: 我希望這能為你鋪平道路，讓你沐浴在奧丁的光輝中。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
Mmmm...
A Holy Pilgrimage isn't that difficult.
Just be mindful that once you start the path you will be on your way to the way of a true minister of Odin.
scripts.translation: 只要記住，踏上朝聖之路，就是向真正侍奉奧丁的牧師邁出了一步。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
Feel free to visit me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 如果你改變主意，隨時可以來找我。

scripts.text: I'll always be here for you.
[Praying Minister]
How's it going?
Did you meet Priest Dayan in Umbala?
scripts.translation: 你在汶巴拉見到達揚牧師了嗎？

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
In front of the Almighty God Odin,
there shall be no person smarter than him,
and there will be no person more merciful than him.
[Praying Minister]
All ministers of Odin should be diligent. They should never be too lazy to serve Odin.
scripts.translation: 奧丁的所有牧師都應勤勉。他們絕不應因懶散而怠慢對奧丁的侍奉。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
These days, I've heard that ministers are becoming lax in their duty to Odin and adorn themselves with the splendors of the world.
scripts.translation: 最近，我聽說有些牧師對侍奉奧丁的職責變得懈怠，反而沉迷於世俗的榮華富貴。

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
If you see any of these ministers, can you ask to them to go to the church in Prontera?
scripts.translation: 如果你遇到這樣的牧師，能否請他們去普隆德拉的教堂一趟？

scripts.text: [Praying Minister]
They give out a special aura so you can easily recognize them.
scripts.translation: 他們會散發出特殊的氣息，所以很容易辨認。

scripts.text: I'm going to make them ministers worthy of serving Odin.
scripts.translation: 我會讓他們成為配得上侍奉奧丁的牧師。

scripts.text: [Utan Boy]
[Priest]
Un...ba... Unba?
[Priest]
Un...ba... Umba?
[Utan Boy]
[Priest]
Is that... right?
Hmm... so...
Um...ma? Umau...ma?
[Utan Boy]
[Priest]
Huuuuuu......

hohohoho.

muttering...

[Priest Dayan]
Ah~, yes.
Yes, I am.
I'm Dayan. Nice to meet you {0}
scripts.translation: 我是達揚。很高興見到你，{0}。

scripts.text: The old priest gives you an ear to ear grin.
scripts.translation: 老牧師對你露出了燦爛的笑容。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
I forgot to wear my hearing aid. hehe.
Anyway, why have you come here?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你來這裡有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm, I wanted to tell you...
Priest Dayan doesn't seem to understand you. He just stares at you and smiles.
scripts.translation: 達揚牧師似乎沒有聽懂你的話。他只是盯著你微笑。

scripts.text: [Priest]
Eh? Say what?
[Priest Dayan]
He cups his ears towards you.
scripts.translation: 他把手攏在耳邊，湊向你。

scripts.text: ^FF0000I'm here for the Holy Pilgrimage!^000000
^FF0000I'm here for the Holy Pilgrimage!^000000
^FF0000I'm here for the Holy Pilgrimage!^000000
^FF0000I'm here for the Holy Pilgrimage!^000000
[Priest Dayan]
Eh... are you?
A pilgrimage to the Holy Land...
It has been a long time since I've seen such a devout minister.
scripts.translation: 我已經很久沒見過這麼虔誠的牧師了。

scripts.text: Welcome. {0}
The old priest gives you a gracious smile.
scripts.translation: 老牧師對你露出了和藹的微笑。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
See this village with the huge forest surrounding it.
scripts.translation: 看看這個被巨大森林環繞的村莊。

scripts.text: Can you see a giant tree?
scripts.translation: 你能看到那棵巨大的樹嗎？

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
That big tree is called The ^3131FFYggdrasil^000000.
That tree was created from Ymir's body after Odin created the world as you know it, Midgard.
scripts.translation: 傳說在奧丁創造了你所熟知的世界——米德加爾特之後，這棵樹是由尤彌爾的身體化成的。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
A fountain pours out from the end of Yggdrasil's roots that spread to every world.
scripts.translation: 世界樹的根系延伸至各個世界，從根部的末端湧出了泉水。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
The roots head to Niflheim where you can find the Hvergelmir spring.
scripts.translation: 根系通向尼弗爾海姆，那裡可以找到赫瓦格密爾之泉。

scripts.text: In Midgard there is Mimir's spring.
scripts.translation: 在米德加爾特有米米爾之泉。

scripts.text: And in Asgard, the world of the Gods, there is the Word spring.
scripts.translation: 而在眾神的世界阿斯加德，則有烏爾德之泉。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Mimir's spring wells with intelligence, myth says that if Odin lets you have his eye that you will gain all of the knowledge within that spring.
scripts.translation: 米米爾之泉湧動著智慧。傳說如果奧丁允許你擁有他的一隻眼睛，你就能獲得泉中蘊含的所有知識。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Through the Holy Pilgrimage, we can make ourselves pious by cleansing our bodies and souls.
scripts.translation: 通過神聖的朝聖之旅，我們可以洗滌身心，使自己變得虔誠。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Enter the Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 進入世界樹尤克特拉希爾。

scripts.text: You may be assaulted by creatures in there
scripts.translation: 裡面可能會遭到魔物襲擊

scripts.text: but be mindful that their intentions are only to protect the Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 但請記住，它們只是為了保護尤克特拉希爾。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Follow your steps with purpose.
scripts.translation: 懷著堅定的信念前行吧。

scripts.text: If Odin doesn't abandon you, you can reach the beginning of the world at the stem of the Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 只要奧丁沒有拋棄你，你就能抵達世界樹樹幹處的世界起源之地。

scripts.text: When you arrive there, find a quiet place.
scripts.translation: 到了那裡，找一處安靜的地方。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Pray for a life of faith and expiate your sins with a pious mind.
scripts.translation: 懷著虔誠的心祈禱，以信仰度過一生，並贖清你的罪孽。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Admire Odin's omniscience and omnipotence and pray for a wisdom to choose the right path.
scripts.translation: 讚頌奧丁的全知全能，祈求獲得選擇正確道路的智慧。

scripts.text: ^3131FFFeel free to ask me about how to pray^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF如果你想知道如何祈禱，請隨時問我^000000。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Lets see, go to the place of the most famous creature from Odin.
scripts.translation: 讓我想想，去奧丁最著名的生物所在的地方吧。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
After making your pilgrimage, let's have a drink together and talk about your experience.
scripts.translation: 完成朝聖後，讓我們喝一杯，聊聊你的經歷。

scripts.text: - Priest Dayan smiles again. -
scripts.translation: - 達揚牧師再次露出了微笑。-

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
This place is the holiest place in the world, Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 這裡是世界上最神聖的地方，世界樹。

scripts.text: This holy ceremony will brighten your soul.
scripts.translation: 這場神聖的儀式將照亮你的靈魂。

scripts.text: How should I pray?
Cancel.
[Priest Dayan]
Through prayer, we can follow four paths.
scripts.translation: 通過祈禱，我們可以遵循四條道路。

scripts.text: Remember what I say to you now.
scripts.translation: 請記住我現在告訴你的話。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
The 1st way is the ^3131FFway of meditation^000000.
In the way of meditation, we have to be ready to greet Odin with a clear conscience.
scripts.translation: 走上冥想之道，便要做好準備，問心無愧地迎接奧丁。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Meditation starts with a ^3131FFBlessing^000000 which calms your mind down.
scripts.translation: 冥想始於^3131FF天使之賜福^000000，它能讓你平靜下來。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
The 2nd is the ^3131FFway of agony^000000.
Through the way of agony, we reflect on ourselves with confession about our retribution for the deeds of a former life.
scripts.translation: 走上痛苦之道，便要懺悔前世的所作所為，反省自身承受的因果報應。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Don't be afraid of pain. That is a necessity and will be a first step to enter a way to liquidate past wounds.
scripts.translation: 不要害怕痛苦。這是必經之路，也是撫平往日創傷的第一步。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
The 3rd way is the ^3131FFway of joy^000000.
scripts.translation: 第三條道路是^3131FF喜悅之道^000000。

scripts.text: As you rid yourself of pain, your mind will suffer less and you will experience the joy of life as you help and console others.
scripts.translation: 當你擺脫痛苦，心中的苦悶便會減輕；幫助並安慰他人時，你也能體會生命的喜悅。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
They will bless you because you are an existence of joy overcoming an affliction. We call that ^3131FFAspersio^000000.
scripts.translation: 你戰勝了苦難，將喜悅帶給他人，他們也會為你祝福。這便是^3131FF灑水祈福^000000。

scripts.text: You must drink a ^3131FFHoly Water^000000 with appreciation of Aspersio.
scripts.translation: 你要懷著對灑水祈福的感恩之心，飲下^3131FF聖水^000000。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
The last way is the ^3131FFway of light^000000.
You are free from all sin because you were blessed from all creation.
scripts.translation: 蒙受萬物的祝福，你便得以擺脫一切罪孽。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
You were reborn as light, sing a ^3131FFGloria^000000 of joy and soul that loves you.
scripts.translation: 你已重生為光，懷著喜悅，為那些愛你的靈魂唱起^3131FF幸運之頌歌^000000吧。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
After finishing all of these prayers, just stand up with a pious mind.
scripts.translation: 完成所有這些祈禱後，只需懷著虔誠的心站起來。

scripts.text: If your prayer is truthful, Odin will lend you his wisdom.
scripts.translation: 如果你的祈禱是真誠的，奧丁會賜予你智慧。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Are you ready?
Okay, it's time to leave and exculpate yourself.
If your prayer is finished, let's talk.
scripts.translation: 祈禱結束後，再回來找我聊聊。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
I hope that my prayer can weaken your agony...
scripts.translation: 我希望我的祈禱能減輕你的痛苦...

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Oh, you've come back.
I can feel that you have a fresh energy.
scripts.translation: 我能感覺到你充滿了新的活力。

scripts.text: Maybe you did pray truthfully.
scripts.translation: 也許你確實真誠地祈禱了。

scripts.text: I feel light-hearted. Like I was just reborn...
scripts.translation: 我感到輕鬆。就像剛剛重生了一樣...

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Your faith gives you confidence and courage.
scripts.translation: 信仰賦予你自信與勇氣。

scripts.text: A smile from a peaceful mind will easily rid people of their wariness.
scripts.translation: 發自平和內心的微笑，很容易讓人放下戒備。

scripts.text: Please, inspire people with love and energy.
scripts.translation: 請用愛與活力去鼓舞他人吧。

scripts.text: Thanks for your kind words.
[Priest Dayan]
Now, there is a place you should go to.
scripts.translation: 現在，有個地方你應該去。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
That place is Hugel in Schwarzwald.
scripts.translation: 那個地方是施瓦爾茨瓦爾德的胡格爾。

scripts.text: There is a Nun praying there named Vinue,
scripts.translation: 那裡有一位名叫維努的修女正在祈禱，

scripts.text: she is a true minister who prays for the suffering people in the world.
scripts.translation: 她是一位真正的牧者，為世間受苦的人們祈禱。

scripts.text: But the last time I saw her she seemed sad.
scripts.translation: 不過我上次見到她時，她看起來很悲傷。

scripts.text: [Priest Dayan]
Can you convince her to make a pilgrimage to Yggdrasil?
scripts.translation: 你能勸她前往世界樹進行朝聖嗎？

scripts.text: I think she is exhausted due to praying too much.
scripts.translation: 我想她是因為祈禱太多而精疲力竭了。

scripts.text: I hope the air of Yggdrasil will be helpful to her.
scripts.translation: 我希望世界樹的氣息能對她有所幫助。

scripts.text: Don't worry.
I'll go and meet her.
[Priest Dayan]
Thank you very much.
Feel free to visit here when you want to pray, {0}
scripts.translation: {0}，想祈禱的時候隨時歡迎來這裡。

scripts.text: A visit from a friend always makes me happy.
scripts.translation: 朋友的來訪總是讓我很開心。

scripts.text: [Dayan]
Did you find Vinue in Hugel? How's she doing?
scripts.translation: 你在毀葛找到維努了嗎？她怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: Is it the spring of Hvergelmir.
scripts.translation: 那就是赫維爾蓋爾米爾之泉。

scripts.text: This place is a very vivid and peaceful place.
scripts.translation: 這裡生機盎然，寧靜祥和。

scripts.text: It's proper to pray.
Time to genuflect...
Time to start...
Hmm, what did that priest say to me?
scripts.translation: 嗯，那位牧師對我說了什麼來著？

scripts.text: Hmm... What is the first way?
The way of silence.
The way of confession.
The way of meditation.
The way of silence...?
I don't think so.
The way of confession...?
I don't think so.
The way of meditation...?
Yes, it's the way of meditation.
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe 1st way is the way of meditation.^000000
^3131FFIn the way of meditation, we have to be ready to greet Odin with a clear conscience.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF走上冥想之道，便要做好準備，問心無愧地迎接奧丁。^000000

scripts.text: ^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFMeditation starts with a Blessing which calms your mind down.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF冥想始於天使之賜福，它能讓你平靜下來。^000000

scripts.text: - You close your eyes slowly and take a deep breath. -
scripts.translation: - 你緩緩閉上眼睛，深吸一口氣。-

scripts.text: - * BLESSING! * -
Your mind is refreshed with the blessing effect.
scripts.translation: 在賜福的效果下，你的思緒變得清明。

scripts.text: You continue to meditate trying to rid your mind of any ill feelings.
scripts.translation: 你繼續冥想，試圖驅散心中所有的負面情緒。

scripts.text: ^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe 2nd is the way of agony^000000.
^3131FFThrough the way of agony, we reflect on ourselves with confession about our retribution for the deeds of a former life.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF走上痛苦之道，便要懺悔前世的所作所為，反省自身承受的因果報應。^000000

scripts.text: ^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFDon't be afraid of pain. That is a necessity and will be a first step to enter a way to liquidate past wounds.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF不要害怕痛苦。這是必要的，也是邁向治癒過往創傷的第一步。^000000

scripts.text: Pain... What kind of faults have I had?
scripts.translation: 痛苦...我究竟犯下了什麼過錯？

scripts.text: I confess my guilt to the Almighty God Odin.
scripts.translation: 我向全能的神奧丁懺悔我的罪孽。

scripts.text: Oh benevolent Odin, Take mercy on me and pity me because I'm remiss in the discharge of my duties as a minister.
scripts.translation: 仁慈的奧丁啊，請憐憫我，因為我身為牧師，未能盡到職責。

scripts.text: Please, lead the way and save a foolish minister with your wisdom.
scripts.translation: 求你指引道路，用你的智慧拯救我這個愚蠢的牧師。

scripts.text: You ruminate about your confession and are lost in thought again.
scripts.translation: 你反覆思索自己的懺悔，再次陷入沉思。

scripts.text: ^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe 3rd way is the way of joy.^000000
^3131FFAs you rid yourself of pain, your mind will suffer less and you will experience the joy of life as you help and console others.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF擺脫痛苦後，心靈的折磨便會減輕。幫助、安慰他人，也會讓你體會到生命的喜悅。^000000

scripts.text: ^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFAnd also they will bless you because you are an existence of joy overcoming an affliction. We call that Aspersio^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你戰勝了苦難，將喜悅帶給他人，他們也會為你祝福。這便是灑水祈福^000000。

scripts.text: ^3131FFYou must drink a Holy Water with appreciation of Aspersio.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你要懷著對灑水祈福的感恩之心，飲下聖水。^000000

scripts.text: ^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFYou're drinking the Holy Water.^000000
Oh no! I forgot to bring a Holy Water!
- You bow respectfully holding up a Holy Water and put the glass to your lips. -
scripts.translation: - 你恭敬地鞠躬，舉起聖水，將杯子送到唇邊。-

scripts.text: - * ASPERSIO ! * -
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe last way is a way of light^000000.^000000.
^3131FFYou are free from all sin because you were blessed from all creation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你因受到萬物的祝福而擺脫了一切罪孽。^000000

scripts.text: ^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFYou were reborn as light, sing a Gloria of joy and soul that love you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你已重生為光，懷著喜悅，為那些愛你的靈魂唱起幸運之頌歌吧。^000000

scripts.text: - You breath in deep and start to sing a Gloria.
scripts.translation: - 你深吸一口氣，開始吟唱幸運之頌歌。

scripts.text: A chord crashes out in the spring of Hvergelmir and a waterfall sound gives you a refreshing feeling. -
scripts.translation: 和聲在赫瓦格密爾之泉迴盪，瀑布的水聲令人神清氣爽。-

scripts.text: ~Descendants of Heimdal gather under the Ash tree Yggdrasil.~
scripts.translation: ~海姆達爾的後裔，齊聚於白蠟樹世界樹之下。~

scripts.text: ~The Curdan bird which sits on a branch brings me the wisdom of whole world.~
scripts.translation: ~棲息枝頭的庫丹鳥，賜我世間一切智慧。~

scripts.text: ~The Curdan wolf protects me from all threats in the world.~
scripts.translation: ~庫丹之狼保護我免受世間一切威脅。~

scripts.text: ~The host of ballascalf, rise up from your seat. The whole world shouts for joy.~
scripts.translation: ~巴拉斯卡爾夫之主，請從寶座上起身，世間萬物為之歡呼。~

scripts.text: ~The father of light, the poet of wisdom, sing for me.~
scripts.translation: ~光明之父，智慧的詩人，請為我歌唱。~

scripts.text: ~The host of a glittering glass, give me a holy prediction.~
scripts.translation: ~輝煌琉璃殿的主人，請賜我神聖的預言。~

scripts.text: - After you finish the song, you feel light and strong with abundant devotion. -
scripts.translation: - 歌聲結束後，你感到身心輕盈，充滿了虔誠的力量。-

scripts.text: That was refreshing.
I guess I should go back to Priest Dayan.
scripts.translation: 我想我該回去找達揚牧師了。

scripts.text: The song is over. It's time to go back to Priest Dayan.
scripts.translation: 歌唱結束了。是時候回去找達揚牧師了。

scripts.text: - There is a nun closing her eyes as she murmurs something which sounds like a prayer. -
scripts.translation: - 一位修女閉著眼睛，低聲吟誦著聽起來像祈禱文的話語。-

scripts.text: Talk to her.
Stay Quiet.
- You don't feel like disturbing her -
Umm, hello sister?
[Vinue]
Ah, Welcome.
It's not time to have a service yet...
scripts.translation: 現在還不是舉行儀式的時候...

scripts.text: Are you here to pray, {0}?
I came here to say hello from Priest Dayan from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 我替普隆德拉的達揚牧師向你問好。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
Ah, Priest Dayan.
Is he good?
He is so cute even though he's old.
scripts.translation: 雖然年紀大了，但他真的很可愛。

scripts.text: He told me that he was worried because when he saw you last time, you seemed sad.
scripts.translation: 他說上次見到你時，你看起來很傷心，所以很擔心。

scripts.text: He asks you to go on a Holy Pilgrimage.
scripts.translation: 他邀請你去進行一次神聖的朝聖。

scripts.text: Umbala has the vital power of nature!
scripts.translation: 汶巴拉擁有自然的活力！

scripts.text: [Vinue]
Ah...
He's very kind. As are you {0}.
[Vinue]
But don't worry.
I'm just a little tired because of a bad dream.
scripts.translation: 我只是因為做了個噩夢有點累。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
Evil is always watching for our souls.
scripts.translation: 邪惡總是在窺視我們的靈魂。

scripts.text: If you are indifferent to praying, it never misses an opportunity.
scripts.translation: 如果你對祈禱漠不關心，它絕不會錯過任何機會。

scripts.text: A dream? What kind of dream?
Your soul should be fine.
[Vinue]
Oh but that's where you're wrong.
My soul may be the most at risk.
scripts.translation: 我的靈魂可能正處於最危險的境地。

scripts.text: Thank you for delivering the message.
I'll go back to my prayers.
[Vinue]
That is...
Actually I started to have a bad dream from the date I was appointed.
scripts.translation: 從我被任命的那天起，我就開始做噩夢了。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
At first, it was a dream that Valkyrie was sad and in darkness.
scripts.translation: 起初，夢裡的瓦爾基里很悲傷，籠罩在黑暗之中。

scripts.text: Valkyrie?
[Vinue]
Yeah...
She was crying in a pitch-black room.
scripts.translation: 她在漆黑的房間裡哭泣。

scripts.text: Hanging down like a bird that had its wings cut.
scripts.translation: 低垂著頭，就像一隻被折斷翅膀的鳥。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
But, as time went by, the dream became scarier. Now Valkyrie is arrested with chains and then finally she is dashed to pieces.
scripts.translation: 但隨著時間推移，夢變得越來越可怕。現在瓦爾基里被鎖鏈束縛，最後被摔得粉碎。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
What a cruel performance! I suddenly can't breathe properly and then I wake up.
scripts.translation: 多麼殘酷的景象！我突然無法呼吸，然後驚醒過來。

scripts.text: To have to see the death of Valkyrie, must be a tormenting dream.
scripts.translation: 不得不目睹瓦爾基里的死亡，這一定是個折磨人的夢。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
Is it just a nightmare?
Or do you think it is an omen?
scripts.translation: 還是你認為這是一個預兆？

scripts.text: [Vinue]
I've been wanting to pray at Odin's shrine to make the dream go away. But that shrine became a den of evil a long time ago.
scripts.translation: 我一直想前往奧丁的神殿祈禱，讓噩夢消失。但那個神殿很久以前就變成了邪惡的巢穴。

scripts.text: The shrine?
Nobody tried to subdue the evil?
scripts.translation: 沒有人嘗試過鎮壓那裡的邪惡嗎？

scripts.text: [Vinue]
Unfortunately, I'm a nun who doesn't have any exorcism skill...
scripts.translation: 不幸的是，我只是一個沒有驅魔技能的修女...

scripts.text: Residents of Hugel just stood aghast of the sight because they are not familiar with adventure.
scripts.translation: 毀葛的居民對冒險並不熟悉，只能驚恐地看著這一切。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
These days, there are a lot of people because of the development of the Odin shrine, but their situation is not so good.
scripts.translation: 最近因為奧丁神殿的開發，那裡的人很多，但他們的處境並不好。

scripts.text: Is the dream related with the evil in the Odin shrine?
scripts.translation: 這個夢和奧丁神殿裡的邪惡有關嗎？

scripts.text: [Vinue]
Hum... well.
I don't have any way to find out.
I don't have a method, so I just pray.
scripts.translation: 我沒有別的辦法，只能祈禱。

scripts.text: I'll investgate for you.
I'll pray with you.
[Vinue]
Thank you.
I'll pray that the darkness stays away.
I hope you have a good time with the festival here in Hugel.
scripts.translation: 希望你在毀葛的節日裡玩得開心。

scripts.text: [Vinue]
Yeah?
But, it'll be scary inside!
There are lots of devils inside!
But I can't pretend to ignore a Sister who is in trouble?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼能眼看著修女受苦，卻置之不理呢？

scripts.text: I'm a minister who copes with lots of asceticism!
scripts.translation: 我可是歷經苦修的牧師！

scripts.text: Entrust me.
[Vinue]
Ah... I'm so worried....
I'll never forget your warm heart.
scripts.translation: 我會永遠銘記你的熱心。

scripts.text: How do I get to Odin shrine?
[Vinue]
There is a ferry on the right side of the church.
Ok, wait for good news!
[Vinue]
I'll pray for your safe return.
I hope that Odin gives you his protection as well.
[Vinue]
I'll pray for your safe return.
[Vinue]
I feel refreshed.
It must be good news?
Thank the Gods.
You can see Valkyrie who has a despairing face.
scripts.translation: 你可以看到瓦爾基里絕望的面容。

scripts.text: Touch Valkyrie's Illusion.
Turn away.
You lose your consciousness while getting a closer view of Valkyrie's Illusion.
scripts.translation: 當你更近距離地觀察瓦爾基里的幻象時，你失去了意識。

scripts.text: Out of fear, you turn away from Valkyrie's illusion.
scripts.translation: 出於恐懼，你轉身離開了瓦爾基里的幻象。

scripts.text: - Wait a Sec !! -
- You are carrying too many items, -
- you won't be able to obtain any new items. -
- Please take off some items -
- and come for the challenge again. -
[Valkyrie]
If you want to talk with me, you have to ^3131FFcancel all contracts^000000 with any mercenaries you have.
scripts.translation: 如果你想和我說話，你必須^3131FF解除^000000與所有僱傭兵的契約。

scripts.text: You can't progress without using all your skill points. Please use all of your skill points before progressing~
scripts.translation: 在沒有用完所有技能點的情況下無法繼續。請在繼續之前用完所有技能點~

scripts.text: [Valkyrie]
In the heavens the sound of pipes spread out, but a bird that can't fly crawls and finally is crushed to pieces on the ground.
scripts.translation: 天際笛聲迴盪，折翼之鳥卻只能匍匐於地，最終粉身碎骨。

scripts.text: Ah, I'm resentful! so regretful!
- Valkyrie holds its face, then she finds you and stares with a threatening face. -
scripts.translation: - 瓦爾基里捂著臉，隨後發現了你，目光兇狠地瞪過來。-

scripts.text: [Valkyrie]
You are a descendant of Heimdal living in pain as a mortal, why are you in here?
scripts.translation: 海姆達爾的後裔、在痛苦中掙扎的凡人，你為何來到這裡？

scripts.text: Are you here to ridicule my grim fate?
scripts.translation: 是來嘲笑我悲慘的命運嗎？

scripts.text: No way!
But it's true that I'm here for you.
scripts.translation: 不過，我確實是為你而來的。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Of course I'm staying in Midgard, but we are under the yoke of fate that can't coexist in this world.
scripts.translation: 我雖身在米德加爾特，你我卻受命運束縛，無法在這個世界共存。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I see, is your goal to enter Valhalla?
scripts.translation: 我明白了，你的目標是進入英靈殿？

scripts.text: If you do, it's the wrong place for you.
scripts.translation: 如果是那樣，你選錯了地方。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I was already expelled from Asgard.
scripts.translation: 我早已被逐出阿斯加德。

scripts.text: My duty is protecting this small island from humans trying to take it from the Gods and even I don't have any energy to do so.
scripts.translation: 我的職責是守護這座小島，不讓人類從眾神手中奪走它。可如今，我連這點力量也沒有了。

scripts.text: It's not that kind of problem.
But someone who perceives your painful situation has sent me here.
scripts.translation: 有人察覺到你的痛苦，托我來看看你。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Haha! You are going to help me?!
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
- Valkyrie gives you a fierce scowl. -
scripts.translation: - 瓦爾基里 安古希爾德狠狠地瞪了你一眼。-

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
In fact, I can't do anything with my body now.
scripts.translation: 事實上，我現在身體動彈不得。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Human, answer me. Are you here to sincerely help me?
scripts.translation: 人類，回答我。你是真心來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
No
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I knew that I couldn't trust a human!
scripts.translation: 我就知道不能相信人類！

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Ok...
I don't have any energy to hold my own, so I have no choice but to trust you.
scripts.translation: 我連支撐自身的力量都沒有了，也只能信任你。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I was a normal Valkyrie that lead soldiers to Valhalla according to the order of Odin.
scripts.translation: 我原本是一名普通的瓦爾基里，按照奧丁的命令引導士兵進入英靈殿。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
But I harmed Freki, one of Odin's wolves, and I was expelled form Asgard without any energy as a Valkyrie with orders to protect this island.
scripts.translation: 可我傷害了奧丁的狼弗雷基，因此被逐出阿斯加德，失去了瓦爾基里的力量，還被命令守護這座島。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I was disgraced, this island is important as a temple for Odin and the various Gods.
scripts.translation: 雖已蒙受恥辱，但這座島是供奉奧丁與眾神的重要聖地。

scripts.text: I tried to do my best to protect this holy place.
scripts.translation: 我仍竭盡所能，守護著這裡。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
But one day, the devil started to gain influence on this island.
scripts.translation: 可有一天，惡魔的勢力開始在島上蔓延。

scripts.text: I don't know why they came here and from where they came from.
scripts.translation: 我不知道它們從何而來，也不知道它們為何來到這裡。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
They sieged the temple and I exhausted my energy trying to fight them all myself.
scripts.translation: 它們圍攻神殿，我獨自奮戰，耗盡了力量。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
The holy shrine was tainted by the devils.
scripts.translation: 神聖的殿堂遭惡魔玷汙。

scripts.text: How long do I have to be under this dishonorable fate!
scripts.translation: 我究竟還要承受這屈辱的命運多久！

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Mortal one, what is your name?
My name is {0}.
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
You told me that you want to help me, right? Even though it disgraces me, I am asking for your help.
scripts.translation: 你說過要幫我，對吧？雖然這讓我感到羞恥，但我還是請求你的幫助。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
This place may look like it was made my humans. Actually, it's a very important monument and also a part of the God's history.
scripts.translation: 這裡看起來像是人類建造的。其實，這是一座非常重要的紀念碑，也是神明歷史的一部分。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I've lost all of my energy and my body is sealed so there is no way for me to protect the shrine.
scripts.translation: 我已耗盡力量，身體也被封印，無力再保護神殿。

scripts.text: You have to send a message to Valhalla to ask for help from a Valkyrie quickly.
scripts.translation: 你必須儘快向英靈殿傳信，請其他瓦爾基里前來支援。

scripts.text: How can I do that?
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
At the ^3131FFtop of the shrine^000000, You can contact to them with a ^3131FFGolden pipe^000000.
scripts.translation: 到^3131FF神殿頂端^000000，用^3131FF金色號角^000000就能與她們聯絡。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I'm going to give you a scroll of paper written in an ancient language.
scripts.translation: 我會給你一張用古語寫成的紙卷。

scripts.text: In that scroll, there is my impersonation.
scripts.translation: 那張紙卷裡有我的化身。

scripts.text: ^3131FFIf you go outside, you can summon a Valkyrie with that scroll.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF如果你走到外面，可以用那張紙卷召喚出瓦爾基里。^000000

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
After you summon my impersonation, you have to find a ^3131FFBroken pipe^000000.
scripts.translation: 召喚出我的化身後，去尋找^3131FF號角碎片^000000。

scripts.text: Maybe it'll be spread in the shrine...
scripts.translation: 它們大概散落在神殿各處...

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
You have to go to the top of the shrine, collecting all broken pipes from the impersonation.
scripts.translation: 你要藉助化身收集所有號角碎片，前往神殿頂端。

scripts.text: And then I'm going to take care of the matter.
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
An impersonation will help when you move or attack as you want through ^FF0000ALT+click^000000.
scripts.translation: 化身可以協助你移動或攻擊，按住^FF0000ALT+點選^000000即可操控它。

scripts.text: But you have to be careful if an imeprsonation falls down.
scripts.translation: 若化身倒下了，你要格外小心。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
When you finish preparing to go on, talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 當你準備好出發時，再跟我說話。

scripts.text: It'll be a long journey...
scripts.translation: 這將是一段漫長的旅程...

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
{0} Did you finish preparing for your way of asceticism?
scripts.translation: {0}，你準備好開始你的苦行之路了嗎？

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Hmm, someone is battling the devil in the shrine right now.
scripts.translation: 嗯，現在有人正在神殿裡與惡魔戰鬥。

scripts.text: You just wait a minute while I'm finding who it is.
scripts.translation: 請稍等片刻，我去看看是誰。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Ok. Now I'm going to send you there.
scripts.translation: 好的。現在我要送你去那裡。

scripts.text: ^FF0000When you go there, you have to summon my impersonation with the scroll^000000. Don't forget.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000當你到達那裡時，必須用紙卷召喚我的化身^000000。別忘了。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I'm talking with another person now, so give me a second.
scripts.translation: 我現在正在和另一個人說話，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Are you ok human?
It was not as easy as I expected.
scripts.translation: 這並不像我預期的那麼容易。

scripts.text: Will you challenge again?
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Hmm, someone is battling the devil in the shrine right now.
scripts.translation: 嗯，現在有人正在神殿裡與惡魔戰鬥。

scripts.text: You just wait a minute while I'm finding who it is.
scripts.translation: 請稍等片刻，我去看看是誰。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
OK. now I'm going to send you there.
scripts.translation: 好的。現在我要送你去那裡。

scripts.text: ^FF0000When you go there, you have to summon my impersonation with the scroll^000000.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000當你到達那裡時，必須用紙卷召喚我的化身^000000。

scripts.text: An impersonation will help when you move or attack as you want through ^FF0000ALT+click^000000.
scripts.translation: 當你想移動或攻擊時，可以通過^FF0000ALT+點選^000000來操控化身。

scripts.text: But you have to be careful if an impersonation falls down.
scripts.translation: 但如果化身倒下了，你必須小心。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I'm talking with another person now, so give me a second.
scripts.translation: 我現在正在和另一個人說話，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie]
If you want to talk with me, you have to ^3131FFcancel all contracts^000000 with any mercenaries you have.
scripts.translation: 如果你想和我說話，你必須^3131FF解除^000000與所有僱傭兵的契約。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
The devil always makes an effort to agitate people's mind.
scripts.translation: 惡魔總是試圖擾亂人們的心智。

scripts.text: You don't have to care about their whisperings.
scripts.translation: 你不必在意它們的低語。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Anyway I can feel my energy coming back.
scripts.translation: 不管怎樣，我感覺我的能量正在恢復。

scripts.text: Show me the stuff that you found.
scripts.translation: 讓我看看你找到的東西。

scripts.text: - You show a golden piece of pipe to Valkyrie. -
scripts.translation: - 你向瓦爾基里展示了一塊金色的號角碎片。-

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Oh, It's a piece of pipe!
If you collect pieces, you can ask other Valkyries for help.
scripts.translation: 集齊碎片，就能向其他瓦爾基里求助了。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Because of a close battle, I could only get a little energy.
scripts.translation: 由於激烈的戰鬥，我只恢復了一點點能量。

scripts.text: I'm going to give a ^3131FFnew ancient scroll^000000.
scripts.translation: 我會給你一張^3131FF新的古語紙卷^000000。

scripts.text: It'll be helpful to find the rest of pieces.
scripts.translation: 它會幫助你找到剩下的碎片。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Then I look forward to good news.
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Did you find the rest of the pieces?
scripts.translation: 你找到剩下的碎片了嗎？

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Hum?
I can see this one beside you.
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
OK.
I'll complete the broken horn pipe!
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
But the battle is not finished yet.
You remember a ^3131FFruined shrine on the center of the island^000000?
scripts.translation: 還記得^3131FF島嶼中央那座破敗的神殿^000000嗎？

scripts.text: It'll be completed only when you use a horn pipe.
scripts.translation: 去那裡吹響號角，才算大功告成。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I can feel the air around me is getting impure.
scripts.translation: 周圍的氣息正變得汙濁。

scripts.text: And feel the coldness of the pitch-black darkness.
scripts.translation: 漆黑的暗影散發著寒意。

scripts.text: This time will be dangerous.
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I give you a necklace as a present.
scripts.translation: 我送你一條項鍊作為禮物。

scripts.text: But I'm not sure that It'll be helpful or not....
scripts.translation: 但我不確定它是否會有幫助...

scripts.text: Take care.
Please, hurry up!
- Wait a Sec !! -
- You are carrying too many items, -
- you won't be able to obtain any new items. -
- Please take off some items -
- and come for the challenge again. -
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation: 請先解除騎乘狀態，再試一次！

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Did you collect all of the pieces of my horn pipe?
scripts.translation: 你收集齊我號角的所有碎片了嗎？

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I know you bent over backwards to help me, but I can't do anything without 2 pieces of horn pipe.
scripts.translation: 我知道你竭盡全力幫助我，但沒有兩塊號角碎片，我什麼都做不了。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
It can be dangerous, so let's go back.
scripts.translation: 可能會有危險，我們回去吧。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Finally we finished all the preparations.
scripts.translation: 終於，我們完成了所有準備。

scripts.text: Valkyrie holds the pipe and blows towards the sky.
scripts.translation: 瓦爾基里舉起號角，朝天空吹響。

scripts.text: Booo - - - -
Booo - - -
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Assistance of Odin! Soldiers of Valhalla!
scripts.translation: 奧丁的侍從們！英靈殿的戰士們！

scripts.text: The holy place of the God Odin is tainted by darkness!
scripts.translation: 奧丁的聖地已遭黑暗玷汙！

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Don't worry, Anguhilde.
Your desire has reached Valhalla.
scripts.translation: 你的願望已經傳到了英靈殿。

scripts.text: The devils were removed by other Valkyries as you wanted.
scripts.translation: 正如你所願，惡魔已被其他瓦爾基里清除。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Valkyries! Then is it safe now?
scripts.translation: 瓦爾基里們！那麼現在安全了嗎？

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Yes Anguhilde.
Even though you were expelled because of an incident before, Odin said that he is reconsidering your banishment.
scripts.translation: 雖然你之前因為事故被放逐，但奧丁說他會重新考慮對你的放逐。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Ah! I can go back to Asgard!
scripts.translation: 啊！我可以回到阿斯加德了！

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Don't make a hasty generalization.
But I think that good news will be sent to you.
scripts.translation: 但我相信，好訊息會傳到你那裡。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Honor to Odin!
I feel full of grace.
So bright and warm....
- Shoooo -
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Set your mind at ease.
She went to a place where she is supposed to be.
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
I think you don't get it.
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Anguhilde is a Valkyrie who is dead for a long time ago.
scripts.translation: 安古希爾德早已死去多年。

scripts.text: Didn't you see a shrine covered by the devil?
scripts.translation: 你看見那座被惡魔佔據的神殿了吧？

scripts.text: Unfortunately, Anguhilde couldn't cope with the task and fell down.
scripts.translation: 很遺憾，她沒能完成守護神殿的使命，最終倒下了。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Here is an illusion of Anguhilde who doesn't want to be recognized.
scripts.translation: 你在這裡見到的，是安古希爾德不願承認現實的幻象。

scripts.text: She can't go to hell even when she is dead, and struggles from her constant nightmare.
scripts.translation: 她死後仍無法前往冥界，一直困在無盡的噩夢中。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
But she is relieved by your favor.
scripts.translation: 而你的善意讓她得到了解脫。

scripts.text: Even though It's different with reality but now she may be able to rest in peace.
scripts.translation: 雖與現實不同，但如今她終於能安息了。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Human, the Valkyries are in your debt. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 人類，瓦爾基里們欠你一份恩情。謝謝你。

scripts.text: I can't invite you as I want, but the power given by Odin can help you.
scripts.translation: 我雖想邀請你前往英靈殿，卻無法如願。不過，可以用奧丁賜予的力量來幫助你。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Now, go back to your world.
scripts.translation: 現在，回到你的世界去吧。

scripts.text: The sound of the horn pipe and a bird's chirpings will be spread out for you.
scripts.translation: 號角聲和鳥鳴聲將為你奏響。

scripts.text: You can't progress without using all your skill points. Please use all of your skill points before progressing~
scripts.translation: 在沒有用完所有技能點的情況下無法繼續。請在繼續之前用完所有技能點~

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Don't forget an altruistic minister's spirit like today forever.
scripts.translation: 請永遠保有今天這份為他人著想的牧師之心。

scripts.text: I hope we see each other in Valhalla sometime.
scripts.translation: 但願有朝一日，我們能在英靈殿再會。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Now, go back to your world.
scripts.translation: 現在，回到你的世界去吧。

scripts.text: The sound of the horn pipe and a bird's chirpings will be spread out for you.
scripts.translation: 號角聲和鳥鳴聲將為你奏響。

scripts.text: [Valkyrie of the heavens]
Don't forget an altruistic minister's spirit like today forever.
scripts.translation: 請永遠保有今天這份為他人著想的牧師之心。

scripts.text: I hope we see each other in Valhalla sometime.
scripts.translation: 但願有朝一日，我們能在英靈殿再會。
